metadata.value: U.S. Air Force 2nd Lieutenant Weston (Seth) Kelsey (right), a member of the World Class Athlete Program, duels for advancement against Russian, Ivan Tourchine (left) in the 2nd round of the Olympic Mens Individual Epee event at Helliniko Fencing Hall just outside Athens, Greece. Lieutenant Kelsey did not advance to the third round. Of his first Olympic attempt he said, " I was too timid, more nervous than I should have been. I need some more (international) experience and I'll be back"
